title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
keywords: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
abstract: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

analysis.ideaZh: MT Forcing最值得记住的是：每轮marginal匹配并不能保证跨轮一致。它用累计指令的一次teacher编辑稳定student self-rollouts，再保留reference-history监督；八轮结果有改善，但首轮CC下降，Pixel只度量已匹配点位移，不能当编辑正确率。
analysis.motivationZh: 把多轮image editing写成AR diffusion rollout。Teacher每次从原图执行累积编辑，避免teacher自身递归污染；DMD只约束累计意图条件下的边缘分布，因而加入reference trajectories上的flow-matching warmup与持续regularization。价值在于将visual-quality与history-dependence拆开，而非给设计agent外接一个现成无训练插件。
analysis.methodZh: 将历次instructions重组为从原图执行的bundled prompt。 对reference histories做teacher-forcing warmup，初始化student/frozen teacher/fake-score model。 Student用自己的KV历史self-rollout，teacher只看source image与累计意图。 对当前turn做Single-Turn DMD，历史KV与跨turn梯度detach。 联合低权重reference-trajectory flow matching，保留history-dependent transitions。

analysis.experimentsZh: 两个SenseNova U1/U1.5 backbone，MTEdit-Bench stepwise的100会话×8轮。IF/CC使用VLM judge，DRS结合两个IQA评分，Pixel用MatchAnything-RoMa。 作者报告U1.5第8轮IF4.52→9.17、CC3.22→7.68；第1轮CC9.49→8.82，不能称各轮全面提高。 (Table1, PDF p.7) 作者报告八轮平均Pixel6.34→0.74，full IF9.66/CC8.40；Pixel只在valid matches上测量。 (Table2, PDF p.8; Sec.4.1, p.6) 主表比较两个base editor before/after，没有与Related Work中多轮SOTA的matched-budget主表对照；核心benchmark仅100会话8轮，未给独立human preference或长时编辑正确率。 DMD-only、TF-only、combined和TF权重0.1/0.25/0.5/1；支持两项互补，但warmup与持续regularization未完全分别控制，训练总预算/数据细节在此v1不完整。
analysis.insightZh: 把single-turn teacher的质量参照用于multi-turn rollout marginals，并以反例说明zero marginal DMD仍可忽略历史；Teacher-Forcing Guidance补足conditional trajectory监督。DMD/AR diffusion本身是已有技术。
analysis.evidenceZh: 原图+累计指令是弱条件；DMD仅匹配rollout marginal。 (Sec.3.2, Eqs.3–6, PDF pp.4–5) / 独立每轮采样teacher可令理想DMD为零但图案仍变化。 (Sec.3.3 Eq.7 and Fig.4, PDF p.5) / warmup之后继续保留reference-history regularization。 (Sec.3.3 Eq.9, Algorithm1, PDF p.6) / 100 sessions×8turn，IF/CC由Qwen3.5-Plus评分，Pixel是valid matches的平均位移。 (Sec.4.1, PDF p.6) / U1.5第8轮IF9.17/CC7.68，对照4.52/3.22，但第1轮CC9.49→8.82。 (Table1, PDF p.7) / DMD-only与guidance-only各有收益，full八轮均值IF9.66/CC8.40/DRS4.30/Pixel0.74。 (Table2, PDF p.8)
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接可迁移到design agent反复编辑的history preservation训练：把累计意图正确与前次渲染细节不变分开监督，未验证SVG/embroidery结构。
analysis.caveatZh: Sec.3.3指出marginal matching不保证trajectory consistency。 / 较大TF权重出现blur，Fig.7展示细节/一致性trade-off。 / 自动judge/IQA可能偏向保守输出；Pixel很低也可能缺少应有变化或只留下易匹配点。 / 首轮IF/CC在U1.5下降，不能声称无代价。 / 不是面向任意编辑器的免训练方法；需reference trajectories、teacher和online fake-score model。 / 主表8轮内有效，不把project较长示例当独立定量验证。
